subject: South Africa
assessment: ANALYSIS: South Africa exhibits High friction primarily from energy infrastructure bottlenecks (recurring load shedding, grid decay) and regulatory permitting delays, with Systemic Resilience at 0.65. Friction quantified at 38/100 against Global Infrastructure Readiness of 78. RESOLUTION: Protocol deployment mitigates friction via renewable energy integration, policy streamlining, and calibrated skills dispatch to stabilize SHI. DISPATCH: Creative skills (digital innovation hubs) to African Creative Economy; Technical skills (renewable engineering, ICT infrastructure) to Sustainable Energy and Tech Avenues; Operational skills (logistics, energy management) to Infrastructure Resilience Labs; Labor skills (local workforce upskilling) to Skills Export and Development Programs; Intellectual skills (R&D partnerships) to Knowledge Economy Corridors -> Global Industry Avenues.
